blocks.p: Classe abstract = ne peut PAS etre instanciee. Sert de modele aux enfants.

blocks.code:
<?php
abstract class Shape {
    abstract public function area(): float;

    public function describe(): string {
        return 'Aire = ' . $this->area();
    }
}

class Circle extends Shape {
    public function __construct(private float $r) {}
    public function area(): float {
        return pi() * $this->r ** 2;
    }
}

class Square extends Shape {
    public function __construct(private float $s) {}
    public function area(): float {
        return $this->s ** 2;
    }
}

// $s = new Shape();   // Erreur fatale
$c = new Circle(3);
echo $c->describe();

blocks.tip: Force toutes les classes enfants a implementer la methode abstraite.
